name: Risk-on dual gate + on-chain demand cross arms BB-z washout (active-address confirmation)
rationale: THESIS: the dual macro/vix regime gate arms a bb_z washout, but we add a DRIFTING on-chain confirmation — btc_active_addresses crossing UP (network demand turning back on) — to separate a washout that the chain is already buying from one still bleeding. btc_active_addresses is a drifting level so it is used ONLY via cross_up (never a raw level threshold). The on-chain cross is the timing refinement on top of the macro/vix arming. DISCONFIRMER 1 (does on-chain add over the dual gate alone?): spec-1 (same dual gate + bb_z, NO on-chain cross) is the direct baseline; if adding the cross does not raise deflated Sharpe it is noise. DISCONFIRMER 2 (just buy-the-washout?): ungated bb_z control. DISCONFIRMER 3 (is active-addresses a stand-in for price momentum?): a sibling replacing the on-chain cross with a ret_Nd>0 momentum confirm tests whether the chain carries info beyond price. DISCONFIRMER 4 (holdout).
catalyst: btc_active_addresses crosses up while macro_regime risk-on, vix calm, and bb_z washed out
